item.title: Sensometrics 2026
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in Food Quality and Preference focuses on sensometrics, the application of statistical and multivariate analytical methods to sensory science data. The issue welcomes research that advances methodological approaches in sensory evaluation and analysis.

item.title: Sensory is everywhere, beyond food. Expanding the horizon of sensory and consumer science
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites researchers to explore sensory and consumer science methodologies and concepts in domains beyond traditional food applications. The call encourages submissions that demonstrate how sensory evaluation techniques and consumer research approaches can be applied to non-food products and contexts, broadening the scope and relevance of these scientific disciplines.

Appel publié par Food Quality and Preference. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Sensory science applications beyond food
  • Consumer science
  • Expanding sensory research horizons

Timeline

  • November 30, 2026: Submission deadline
